description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_MakeAbsolute, which is a URI filter responsible for converting relative URIs into absolute URIs based on a configured base URI. It includes methods to prepare the filter with configuration data, to apply the filtering to a given URI, and a private method to resolve dots and double dots in URI path segments.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_MakeAbsolute
classes.description: A URI filter class that converts relative URIs to absolute URIs using a base URI.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration data, setting the base URI and preparing the path stack.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Transforms a given URI to an absolute URI based on the base URI, handling relative paths and special cases.

methods.name: _collapseStack
methods.description: Resolves '.' and '..' segments in URI paths to simplify and normalize the path.
